stories.title: Japan Announces Emergency Cybersecurity Package Following a Wave of Attacks
stories.description: The emergency package comes after dozens of companies and government agencies were hit by unauthorized access to their systems and leaks of client data, prompting uneasiness across Japan.

stories.title: Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time
stories.description: WordPress sites can remain exposed to code execution while installing the fix for actively exploited CVE-2026-119977 through vulnerable updates.

stories.title: Hackers Target OpenSSH SSHole Flaw Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot
stories.description: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-123158 in OpenSSH, with root access confirmed on an Alpine Linux honeypot. OpenSSH 10.6p2 fixes the flaw.

stories.title: New Dark Project Ransomware Group Offers Hackers 80% Commission to Expand Cyberattacks
stories.description: A ransomware group called Dark Project is recruiting criminal partners with an offer of 80% of proceeds from successful attacks, pairing generous commissions with a platform for managing extortion. First observed in June 2026, the financially motivated…

stories.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Cyber After AI Helps Find 81 Firefox Flaws, 948 Linux Exploits
stories.description: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 Cyber, reporting 948 Linux privilege escalation exploits and 81 unknown Firefox flaws discovered with its help.

stories.title: In Other News: Trezor Implant, LLMJacking Bills Hit $1M, SAP Flaws Weaponized Within Days
stories.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Synology warns about NAS ransomware attacks, Flowise ‘hello’ attacks, Chainalysis breach impact expands.

stories.title: Microsoft Warns Fake Game Downloads Are Secretly Monetizing Windows PCs
stories.description: Fake game downloads secretly monetize Windows PCs by installing bandwidth-sharing software and unwanted utilities.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Claude Code Reportedly Leaks User Email Addresses Through HTTP User-Agent Headers
stories.description: Anthropic’s Claude Code is facing privacy concerns after a user reported that the AI coding tool sent their email address to third-party websites through HTTP User-Agent headers during web searches, without permission.

stories.title: Hackers Launch 240,000 Exploit Attempts WordPress Core Flaw Enabling Remote Code Execution
stories.description: Hackers have launched more than 240,000 exploit attempts against a WordPress Core vulnerability that can allow attackers to run malicious code without logging in.

stories.title: DigiCert Data Breach Impacts Business Customer Information
stories.description: Hackers created an account on an internal system and accessed names, email addresses, phone numbers, and business addresses.

stories.title: OpenAI Says New GPT-6 Cyber Model Hunts Flaws Without Crossing the Line
stories.description: Rated Critical for cybersecurity, OpenAI’s new model beats GPT-5.6 Cyber at exploitation while staying in scope more reliably.

stories.title: Microsoft Paint RCE Fix Now Available, but Windows Update Won't Deliver It
stories.description: Microsoft Store now offers Paint 11.2609.401.0 to fix CVE-2026-83844, an RCE flaw; Windows Update does not deliver the fix.
